intro.title: Word Ladder
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a Word Ladder solver, a program that finds the shortest sequence of words connecting two given words by changing one letter at a time. You will learn to apply the Breadth-First Search (BFS) algorithm to explore possible word transformations efficiently. The implementation will involve core JavaScript constructs like arrays, queues, sets, and string manipulation. By the end, you'll understand how BFS guarantees the shortest path and can solve this classic puzzle programmatically.
intro.usecase: The Word Ladder algorithm is a classic graph search problem used in real-world applications like spell-checkers, word games, and language processing tools. For example, in a word puzzle game UI, it can find the shortest sequence of valid words between a start and target word, enhancing user engagement. It also powers features in writing assistants that suggest synonym chains or vocabulary expansion paths. Understanding this pattern helps developers build intelligent text-based features in educational software, search engines, and content recommendation systems.
